name: Sailing / Yachting
description: Racing and cruising sailboats and yachts, from Olympic dinghy classes to offshore ocean racing and the America's Cup. One of the oldest organized sports; wind-powered seamanship.

name: Psychoanalysis
description: The therapeutic and theoretical tradition founded by Freud — unconscious drives, repression, transference, and the talking cure. Later schools: Jungian, Kleinian, Lacanian.

name: Tensor Processing Unit (TPU)
description: Google's custom ASIC for neural-network inference and training, optimized for tensor/matrix operations. A key AI accelerator alongside GPUs.

name: Speculative Design
description: Design that uses fictional scenarios and prototypes to question possible futures rather than solve immediate problems. Associated with Dunne & Raby's critical design.
